D2 Simple Gear Trains and Idler Gears: practice

Booklet 5 Drive Systems · Lesson D2

← Back to Lessons

What this page practises

  • I can identify the driver gear and the driven gear.
  • I can state the direction of rotation of each gear.
  • I can describe the function of an idler gear.
  • I can draw a gear train using the correct conventions.
  • I can calculate velocity ratio from input and output speeds.
D2 slides (PDF) D2 slides with answers (PDF)

Warm-up

Say it the exam way

The gear on the input shaft is the gear. The gear on the output shaft is the gear. Two meshing gears turn in directions.

An idler gear makes the driver and driven gears turn in the direction. It has on the output speed.

Velocity ratio = speed of input ÷ speed of . Velocity ratio has . Give the ratio in its form, such as 5 : 2.

Gears are drawn with lines, a double outline and a at the centre.

Check your understanding

Answer in your jotter first. Then open the answer.

1. State the name of the gear on the input shaft.

Show the answer

The driver gear.

2. A driver gear turns clockwise. State the direction of the driven gear it meshes with.

Show the answer

Anticlockwise.

3. State the function of an idler gear.

Show the answer

It makes the driver and the driven gear turn in the same direction.

4. A simple gear train has an input speed of 600 revs min⁻¹ and an output speed of 200 revs min⁻¹. Calculate the velocity ratio.

Show the answer

VR = speed of input ÷ speed of output = 600 ÷ 200 = 3 : 1

5. State two conventions used to draw gears.

Show the answer

Any two: solid lines; two circles (a double outline); a cross at the centre.

6. State the name of the gear on the output shaft.

Show the answer

The driven gear.

7. State the effect of an idler gear on the output speed.

Show the answer

No effect: the output speed does not change.

Errors that cost marks

  • Simplify the ratio: 360 ÷ 12 gives 30 : 1. The marking says the ratio must be simplified (2023, 2024).
  • Name the direction: anticlockwise. "Other way" or "opposite way" got no mark (2019).
  • Say what an idler does: it makes the driver and driven gears turn the same way. "It has no effect on the speed" got no mark (2017 specimen).
  • Say where a new gear goes: between the driver and the driven gear. "Add another gear" alone got no mark (2015).
  • Draw gears with solid lines, a double outline and a cross at each centre, not a dot (2018).

Answers

Say it the exam way

(1) driver · (2) driven · (3) opposite · (4) same · (5) no effect · (6) output · (7) no unit · (8) simplest · (9) solid · (10) cross

Check your understanding

  1. The driver gear.
  2. Anticlockwise.
  3. It makes the driver and the driven gear turn in the same direction.
  4. VR = speed of input ÷ speed of output = 600 ÷ 200 = 3 : 1
  5. Any two: solid lines; two circles (a double outline); a cross at the centre.
  6. The driven gear.
  7. No effect: the output speed does not change.
